paper_ref: An, Ang, Bali, and Cakici, NBER Working Paper No. 19590, October 2013
economic_intuition: Subtracting ΔCVOL from ΔPVOL roughly isolates put-volatility predictability from the common option-volatility component; high put-minus-call changes predict lower returns.
detailed_definition: Monthly change in put implied volatility minus monthly change in call implied volatility.
